blueprint.archive_restore_while_running: Banza utegereze ko umugambi uriho urangira.
blueprint.archive_save_failed: Ntibyashobotse kubika umugambi wabanje — ububiko bushobora kuba bwuzuye.
blueprint.execution_complete_chat: Byarangiye - ibikoresho {count} biri mu isomo ryawe. Mbwira icyo nanoza, cyangwa umbaze icyo ushaka cyose kuri byo.
blueprint.execution_started: Ndimo nubaka ipaki y'isomo ryawe - ibikoresho {count}. Ushobora kugabanya aka gace ukareba uko bigenda bigera.
blueprint.fail_empty: Iyi ntambwe nta cyo yatanze. Niba nta nyandiko-soko ihari, ongeraho cyangwa ukore imwe hanyuma wongere wubake. Niba isoko ihari, igikoresho cyubaka gishobora kuba cyarabujijwe cyangwa kigabanyijwe — tegereza gato hanyuma wongere wubake.
blueprint.keyboard_reorder_instruction: Koresha Zamura na Manura kugira ngo uhindure urutonde utabikuruye.
blueprint.no_source_warning: Nta nyandiko-soko irahari, bityo bimwe mu bikoresho bishobora kudakorwa. Kugira ngo ubone ibisubizo byiza, banza wongereho cyangwa ukore isoko.
blueprint.preview_missing: Icyo gikoresho nticyikiri muri aka gace k'akazi. Ongera wubake intambwe kugira ngo ukikore bushya.
blueprint.preview_unsupported: Ubu bwoko bw'igikoresho bufungurwa mu buryo bwabwo bwite, ntabwo ari mu kureba mbere.
blueprint.run_stopped: Byahagaritswe. Ibikoresho {done} muri {total} byari byarangiye mbere yo guhagarara — ibisigaye byerekana Ongera wubake kugira ngo ubikore kimwe kimwe cyangwa wongere utangire umugambi.
blueprint.stop_run_hint: Irangiza intambwe iriho hanyuma igahagarara. Ibikoresho byarangiye birabikwa.
blueprint.template_directive_help: Bika amabwiriza akwiranye n'ingingo iyo ari yo yose. Siba asobanura IRI somo gusa.
blueprint.template_name_placeholder: urugero: Inyandiko itanga amakuru, amagambo mbere
blueprint.template_picker_title: Tangirira kuri rumwe mu ngero zawe:
blueprint.wait_for_run: Tegereza ko ubwubatsi burangira (cyangwa ubuhagarike) mbere yo guhindura.
